newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends higher on mix of inputs.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends higher on mix of inputs.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures settled higher in moderate dealings on a mix of bullish input, traders said.
Traders said commercial pricing supported wheat early, followed by commission-type buying tied to ideas the market had become technically oversold and was due for a bounce.

Further support came in reaction to a slight decline in USDA's weekly rating of the spring wheat crop. USDA said Monday that 48 percent of the U.S. spring wheat crop was in good to excellent condition, below the 50 percent in that category the previous week.
Gains were capped as Cargill Investor Services sold the September contract throughout the session. Traders said CIS sold about 2.7 million Sept over the course of Tuesday's session.
Traders said spring wheat faltered late and settled below its intraday highs on spillover weakness from CBOT corn.
Traders said ADM was a leading buyer, picking up 1.1 million March bushels. Benson-Quinn, a unit of ADM, bought September on stops.
MGE spring wheat settled 3-1/2 to 4-1/2 cents per bushel higher, with new crop Sept up 4-1/2 cents at $3.51.
MGE estimated spring wheat futures volume at 22.569 million bushels.
